secrets.statusNone: No PIN set for this config. Values can't be locked until you set one.
secrets.statusLocked: Locked — you'll be asked for the PIN when one is needed.
secrets.setHint: Set a PIN to start locking environment values. Locked values are encrypted with it and stored encrypted in config.yaml.
secrets.changeHint: Changing the PIN re-encrypts every locked value in this config. Save afterwards to write the change to disk.
secrets.removeHint: Removing the PIN decrypts every locked value and keeps it marked secret, so it stays masked on screen — but it is then stored in config.yaml as plain text.
secrets.removeConfirm: Remove the PIN? All {count} locked value(s) will be decrypted and stored in config.yaml as plain text.
secrets.warning: There is no recovery: if the PIN is forgotten, every locked value has to be entered again by hand. Treat it like a password, not a 4-digit code — a short numeric PIN can be guessed offline by anyone holding the config file.
